custom_checks.sql: WITH mapped AS (SELECT DISTINCT package_id FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily`), b AS (SELECT _package_id package_id, _date date, SUM(_spend) spend, SUM(_impressions) impressions, SUM(_clicks) clicks, SUM(_video_views) video_views, SUM(_video_comps) video_completions, SUM(_planned_spend) planned_spend, SUM(_planned_impressions) planned_impressions FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` WHERE _package_id NOT IN (SELECT package_id FROM mapped) GROUP BY 1,2), c AS (SELECT _package_id package_id, _date date, SUM(_spend) spend, SUM(_impressions) impressions, SUM(_clicks) clicks, SUM(_video_views) video_views, SUM(_video_comps) video_completions, SUM(_planned_spend) planned_spend, SUM(_planned_impressions) planned_impressions FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__fpd_polaris_separate__data_model_v3` WHERE _package_id NOT IN (SELECT package_id FROM mapped) GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT COUNTIF(ABS(COALESCE(b.spend,0)-COALESCE(c.spend,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.impressions,0)-COALESCE(c.impressions,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.clicks,0)-COALESCE(c.clicks,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.video_views,0)-COALESCE(c.video_views,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.video_completions,0)-COALESCE(c.video_completions,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.planned_spend,0)-COALESCE(c.planned_spend,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.planned_impressions,0)-COALESCE(c.planned_impressions,0)) >= 0.000001 OR (b.package_id IS NULL) != (c.package_id IS NULL)) AS value FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c USING(package_id,date)
